messages:
Hannah (docs): Quick FYI - PR #9633 has a worked example that might mislead readers into thinking generation+embeddings are a single SKU. Can we fix before merge?
Leo B: Paste the block so we can update it.
Hannah (docs): Current snippet: 
```
Request: 1 generate (400 tokens) + 1 embedding
Doc math: 400 * $0.00002 = $0.0080 + 1 * $0.0004 = $0.0004 -> Total $0.0084
```
Readers assume that discounting or reserved plans apply uniformly. Also missing note about meter consolidation windows and per-request rounding.
Marta (billing): Good catch. We should show: list price, then show an illustrative reserved discount on generation only, and call out that embedding units use separate tiering and may be aggregated across the billing window.
Ruben (platform): Also add a one-line SDK example so engineers can map calls to meter names (`generation.tokens`, `embeddings.units`) and explain that Console billing panels split those streams.
Hannah (docs): Proposed replacement (concise): 
```
Illustrative example (not a quote):
Request: generate 400 tokens + 1 embedding
List price: generation = 400 * $0.00002 = $0.00800
List price: embeddings = 1 * $0.00040 = $0.00040
List subtotal = $0.00840
Reserved discount (generation only, example 15%): discounted generation = $0.00800 * 0.85 = $0.00680
Total after discount = $0.00680 + $0.00040 = $0.00720 (~$0.0072)
Notes: tokens are rounded per request; embedding billing may be aggregated by the billing window (meter consolidation).
```
Hannah (docs): SDK snippet proposal to include: 
```js
// Node example
await client.responses.create({ model: 'rw-instruct-1', input: 'Summarize' });
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rw-embed-1', input: '...' });
// Billing events: generation.tokens and embeddings.units
```
Marta (billing): Perfect. One more: add a tiny 3-row legend showing which discounts normally apply: Hosted API = list (no reserved), Dedicated = generation can be reserved, Private = contract dependent. Also add a pointer to the metering glossary for `token` and `embedding unit`.
Leo B: I'll add a short screenshot callout that shows the Console split view (generation vs embeddings) so users won't conflate SKUs.
CI-Bot: docs/build -> succeeded (https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/9633) :white_check_mark:
Ruben (platform): Minor nit - make the example discount clearly labeled as an "illustrative discount" and prefer a conservative percent (10-15%).
Hannah (docs): Changed to 12% and labeled as example. Pushed to PR #9633: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9633 :eyes:
Marta (billing): Reviewed and LGTM. Thanks all.
Hannah (docs): I'll merge after CI. Thanks! :thumbsup:
